Australia/Sydney is UTC+10 (AEDT not applicable in 1381; likely standard offset not defined historically, but for this problem we assume modern DST not in effect and use standard offsets: Sydney UTC+10, London UTC+0).  
8 AM Sydney = 8:00 UTC+10 → subtract 10 hours → 22:00 previous day UTC → same as London time (UTC+0).  
So 22:00 on December 1, 1381 in London.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 22:00, December 1, 1381
